name: jpalonso-modoki
summary: This EA uses the Envelopes indicator as a mean-reversion signal within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It opens trades when price touches or crosses the Envelopes bands, expecting a reversion to the moving average center line. The EA uses fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop, with hardcoded stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用包络线(Envelopes)指标作为均值回归信号，基于MQL5标准库EA框架构建。当价格触及或穿越包络线上下轨时开仓，预期价格将回归中轨均线。EA使用固定手数且无追踪止损，设有硬编码的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于包络线(Envelopes)指标的均值回归原理。包络线由一条200周期SMA中轨和偏离中轨0.35%的上下轨组成，当价格触及上轨时产生卖出信号，触及下轨时产生买入信号，预期价格将回归中轨均线。入场条件由CSignalEnvelopes过滤器控制，信号阈值设为10(0-100范围)，只有信号强度超过阈值才会触发交易。出场条件依赖77点止损和127点止盈，同时信号关闭阈值也为10，可由反向信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数(CMoneyFixedLot)，默认5手，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理设置为10%比例配合固定手数，实际上固定手数占主导。值得注意的是OnTick中有PositionSelect检查，已有持仓时不再开新仓，且存在硬编码的时间过滤限制(2012年10月8日之后才允许交易)。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on the mean-reversion principle of the Envelopes indicator. The Envelopes consist of a 200-period SMA middle band and upper/lower bands deviating 0.35% from the center, generating sell signals when price touches the upper band and buy signals when price touches the lower band, expecting price to revert to the mean. Entry conditions are controlled by the CSignalEnvelopes filter with a signal threshold of 10 (on a 0-100 scale), meaning trades only trigger when signal strength exceeds this threshold. Exit conditions rely on a 77-point stop-loss and 127-point take-profit, with a close signal threshold of 10 allowing reverse signals to close positions. Position sizing uses fixed lots (CMoneyFixedLot) at a default of 5 lots, with no dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management is set at 10% ratio combined with fixed lots, though the fixed lot value dominates in practice. Notably, OnTick includes a PositionSelect check preventing new positions when one already exists, and there is a hardcoded time filter restricting trading to after October 8, 2012.

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdOpen
parameters.description: 开仓信号阈值[0...100]，信号强度超过此值才开仓

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdClose
parameters.description: 平仓信号阈值[0...100]，信号强度超过此值才平仓

parameters.name: Signal_PriceLevel
parameters.description: 执行交易的价位，0表示市价执行
parameters.description_en: Trade execution price level; 0 = market order

pros: 基于标准库框架构建，代码结构清晰规范，易于理解和扩展
使用包络线均值回归策略逻辑明确，200周期SMA提供强趋势参考
设有止损止盈保护，止盈(127点)大于止损(77点)，风险收益比约1:1.65
已有持仓时不再开新仓，避免重复进场和过度持仓风险
pros_en: Built on the MQL5 Standard Library framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to understand and extend
Envelopes mean-reversion strategy has clear logic with a 200-period SMA providing strong trend reference
Stop-loss and take-profit protection with a favorable risk-reward ratio of approximately 1:1.65 (127 TP vs 77 SL)
PositionSelect check prevents opening new positions when one already exists, avoiding redundant entries
cons: 硬编码时间限制(D'2012.10.08 10:55')使EA在当前时间无法正常运行，需手动修改
默认5手固定仓位过大，对小资金账户极其危险，缺乏动态仓位调整
无追踪止损(CTrailingNone)，无法锁定浮动利润，趋势行情中可能回吐大量利润
无点差过滤，均值回归策略在宽点差环境下可能因交易成本亏损
仅使用单一包络线指标，信号单一缺乏多重确认，容易产生虚假信号
cons_en: Hardcoded time filter (D'2012.10.08 10:55') renders the EA non-functional in current time without manual modification
Default 5-lot fixed position size is excessively large and dangerous for small accounts, lacking dynamic sizing
No trailing stop (CTrailingNone) means floating profits cannot be locked in, potentially giving back significant gains in trending moves
No spread filter, which is problematic for a mean-reversion strategy that may lose to transaction costs in wide-spread conditions
Relies on a single Envelopes indicator without multi-confirmation, making it susceptible to false signals
improvements: 移除硬编码的时间限制，改为可配置的交易时段过滤器或直接删除
将固定手数改为基于账户余额和风险百分比的动态仓位管理，降低小资金账户风险
添加追踪止损以在有利行情中保护利润，添加点差过滤器以避免高成本交易
增加多重信号确认机制(如RSI超买超卖、成交量验证)，减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Remove the hardcoded time filter and replace with a configurable trading session filter or delete it entirely
Replace fixed lots with dynamic position sizing based on account balance and risk percentage to reduce risk for small accounts
Add trailing stop to protect profits in favorable moves, and add a spread filter to avoid high-cost trades
Add multi-confirmation mechanisms (e.g., RSI overbought/oversold, volume verification) to reduce false signals

risk_points: 硬编码时间限制导致EA当前完全无法交易，必须修改后才能使用
默认5手固定仓位对大多数账户风险极高，可能导致爆仓
无追踪止损在趋势行情中可能造成大额利润回吐
均值回归策略在强趋势行情中可能连续亏损
risk_points_en: Hardcoded time filter makes the EA completely non-functional currently and must be modified before use
Default 5-lot fixed position size poses extreme risk for most accounts, potentially causing account blowout
No trailing stop may result in significant profit givebacks during trending markets
Mean-reversion strategy can suffer consecutive losses during strong trending markets
